content: We need to determine number of aromatic carbon atoms in the compound. But we have no description of the compound. Possibly the compound is the sample at hand; we can get NMR spectra to infer aromatic carbons. Could also retrieve carbon shifts ranges. But we need the actual compound structure. Maybe we need to request carbon NMR spectra and count aromatic carbon peaks. Use carbon_nmr_spectra tool. That will give a list of chemical shifts. Aromatic carbons typically around 110-160 ppm. Count peaks in that region. Let's do that.
